timing_horizon_note: Weather features span annual and post-monsoon windows contemporaneous with or after crop growth; this pipeline is an exploratory retrospective response estimation, not an advance pre-season operational early-warning forecast.

evaluation.note: Project threshold (above Issue 5's MIN_N of 8): a crop with fewer test rows than this in its smallest fold is flagged low_sample and should not be read on its own.

target_scaling.note: Models are fitted on yield anomaly / per-crop training-fold std and predictions are converted back to kg/ha. Exploratory; selected after inspecting the 2018-2019 test years, so confirm on new years.

climatology_baseline.definition: Mean historical yield anomaly per crop in training fold; global training mean fallback

validation.note: expanding: every year with targets that has at least min_train_years_with_targets earlier years with targets is a test year, trained on ALL earlier years. For our 2015-2019 data: train 2015-2017 -> test 2018, then train 2015-2018 -> test 2019 (forward-chaining targets exist only from 2017, so 2015 and 2016 add no training rows). Other modes (fixed_origin, explicit) are described in yield_forecast/docs/RETRAINING_ON_LONGER_HISTORY.md.

prediction_intervals.note: Derived from in-sample training residuals due to small time series (T=1 in Fold 1); uncalibrated exploratory uncertainty bounds that do not guarantee nominal out-of-fold coverage.

mitigations_status.climate_zone_pooling: PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED (categorical feature conditioning; explicit hierarchical pooling deferred)
mitigations_status.shrinkage_toward_trend: DEFERRED (insufficient time series; baseline acts as shrinkage toward historical crop mean)
